item.text: {"analysis_packet":{"certificate":"The terminal call must reconcile legality obligations separately from uncertain performance assumptions; anchor behavior is evidence, not binding semantics.","witnesses":["The contract requires online one-access-at-a-time processing, capacity safety, and eviction outputs limited to unique integer keys currently cached.","The anchor assumes probation/protected recency structure, ghost-history adaptation, promotion on repeated access, and size-based admission; their causal effects on scan resistance, phase adaptation, and regret are uncertain.","Object-hit and byte-hit objectives can conflict, especially when object sizes vary.","Scan resistance and rapid phase adaptation can conflict with recency retention and protected-segment stability.","The supplied timestamp is publicly available, but the anchor does not use it; the value of temporal evidence remains unresolved.","The anchor records stored sizes on admission and does not visibly revise them on hits; the effect of any size evolution assumptions is unresolved.","Oversized, nonpositive, and zero-capacity cases require terminal reconciliation with the contract's exact return and state obligations."],"obligations":["Preserve the required Policy constructor and access interface.","Maintain evaluator-visible capacity safety for every request.","Return only currently cached, unique integer keys evicted by the current request.","Use only online public information and the Python standard library.","Avoid benchmark, trace, oracle, external-library, networking, subprocess, and provenance-dependent behavior.","Produce one deterministic final artifact whose legality is independently checkable from the public contract."],"exact_actions":["Carry these tensions forward as nonbinding evidence for terminal reconciliation.","Separate hard interface and capacity obligations from uncertain optimization hypotheses.","Require the terminal originator to resolve unresolved assumptions using only the supplied public inputs.","Do not treat anchor structure, anchor provenance, or the candidate hypothesis as executable semantics."]},"artifact_kind":"analysis_only"}
